description: This is a C# source file for a .NET web application that uses ASP.NET Core, Orleans framework, and interacts with grains for distributed computation. It contains program startup code, interface and class definitions for grains, and configuration of Orleans components.

classes.name: LoaderGrain
classes.description: Implements ILoaderGrain for managing forest additions and resets, interacting with other grains.

classes.name: FanOutGrain
classes.description: Represents a fan-out grain with hierarchical children to simulate distributed workload or hierarchy.

classes.name: HardLimitRule
classes.description: Implements IImbalanceToleranceRule, providing a threshold check for imbalance satisfaction.

methods.name: AddForest
methods.description: Adds a new forest by creating and pinging a child grain.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the grain state, including counters and diagnostics.

methods.name: GetResetCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the grain has been reset.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Recursively pings child grains to simulate activity.
